question: Identify the synonym of 'Feeble'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Weak**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Feeble"** means lacking physical strength, especially as a result of age or illness, or lacking in force, energy, or effectiveness. (कमज़ोर, निर्बल)
 
 
• **Example:** The old man’s voice was feeble, barely audible over the noise of the crowd.
 
 
• **"Weak"** means lacking the power to perform physically demanding tasks, or lacking strength or energy. (दुर्बल)
 
 
• **Example:** After the illness, she felt too weak to get out of bed.
 
 
• Hence, "Weak" is the synonym of "Feeble".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Weak**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Strong** (मज़बूत): Having great physical strength or power.
 
 
• **Example:** He is strong enough to lift heavy weights.
 
 
 
• **Loud** (ज़ोरदार): Producing or capable of producing a lot of noise.
 
 
• **Example:** The music at the party was so loud that I couldn’t hear myself think.
 
 
 
• **Heavy** (भारी): Of great weight or dense in terms of mass.
 
 
• **Example:** The box was too heavy for me to carry alone.
 
 

2f:T770,

The correct answer is** option 1.**
